copied_source_replay.method: Copied the listed run.py and ordinary_tree_checked.py into this scratch root's replay directory and ran in the foreground. The three generated result artifact hashes match those printed in the listed RESULTS.json.

set_correspondence_check.fixed_selector: F(T,p) remains fixed at the original tree and rank; leaves sharing a support remain separate tags.
set_correspondence_check.upper_layer: For v in F, A in Ind_p(H_v) meeting W_v maps to B=A union {v}, a size-(p+1) independent set with active tag v; the inverse removes v.
set_correspondence_check.lower_layer: The same construction at rank p-1 maps to size-p lower clones.
set_correspondence_check.count_identity: |C_r(v)|=i_r(H_v)-i_r(R_v); subtracting ranks p and p-1 gives the summand Delta_(p-1)(H_v)-Delta_(p-1)(R_v). Summing tags gives upper clone count minus lower clone count equal to S(T,p).
set_correspondence_check.edge_check: Every old Delete removes one vertex; every old Retag projects to deleting the retagged leaf. A legal switch preserves independence and changes size p+1 to p by deleting exactly two neighbors and inserting the absent support. Replayed positive non-deletion orbit transitions occur in all three listed T_m cases.

scope_fences: Replay covers only T22,p34; T60,p90; and T66,p98, plus full set-level transition checks for m=1,2,3.
A matching saturating all upper clones is stronger than the scalar inequality S(T,p)<=0.
The old T22 deletion-only cut is an inherited old-relation obstruction; it does not refute the expanded relation or the primary aggregate. The supplied T22 complete aggregate is negative.
The CB(8,92) expanded relation remains without an exact flow or deficient cut in the allowed evidence.
